document_title: Tesla's Texas vehicle and Megapack rows read Production. The robot row reads Construction
_note: Slide strings read off the render report's text nodes and each frame's own source line by build_copy.py.
caption:
Tesla's humanoid robot production began in California.

Its row under Tesla's Texas label reads Construction, with no capacity figure. Tesla defines construction as factory and infrastructure buildout plus tool installation. Optimus production began on high volume lines in Fremont.

The vehicle and Megapack rows under the same label read Production. Model Y sits at more than 375,000 a year. The Cybertruck and the Cybercab sit at more than 125,000 each. Megapack sits at 50 GWh.

The table measures installed capacity. Tesla's own footnote says that is not the current production rate. It ties production rates to uptime, component supply, downtime for factory upgrades, regulation and other factors. The update gives no count of Cybercabs built.

How much did Tesla actually make in Texas in the third quarter?

#Tesla #Optimus #Megapack

S2.headline: More than 375,000 Model Y a year, installed
S2.body: Tesla lists Model Y in Texas at more than 375,000 a year of installed capacity, status Production. It also says installed capacity is not the current production rate. The bay is drawn to illustrate.

S4.headline: Tesla says Megafactory Texas began production
S4.body: The table lists Megapack in Texas at 50 GWh, status Production. The update's highlights call the same 50 GWh planned capacity. Each enclosure drawn here stands for a fifth of it.

S5.headline: Construction, with no figure
S5.body: Tesla's Texas row for Optimus gives no capacity figure. Tesla defines construction as buildout and tool installation. Robot production began in Fremont, California. The bay is drawn to illustrate.

S6.headline: Training compute, in megawatts
S6.body: The rows under Tesla's Texas label list Cortex 1 at more than 105 MW and Cortex 2 at more than 120. Tesla plans 400 MW by year end for vehicle and humanoid robot autonomy software and names no place.

S7.headline: The Austin Fab is still under construction
S7.body: Tesla says it kept building the Austin Fab this quarter and plans to start commissioning equipment there in 2027. The steel is drawn to illustrate.

S8.headline: Cybercab deployment began in Austin. Tesla gives no count.
S8.body: The cars go into its Austin Robotaxi fleet. The update gives no count of cars built. Federal regulators are auditing how Tesla certified a car that lacks permanently attached pedals and steering wheel. The car is drawn to illustrate.

S9.headline: A lit bay is a status, not a count
S9.body: Tesla says installed capacity is not the current production rate, which turns on uptime, supply, downtime for upgrades, regulation and other factors. Its update gives no count of Cybercabs built.
